snippet.title: 1883 // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118260/1883/

Welcome to a Victorian town where you'll explore this world through the eyes of a runaway high school girl. Starting off with waking up in a haunted house! A freak is haunting the school?! The town at night is creepy too! The high school girl Taffy will experience a series of supernatural stories

Developed by
Project CherryNova​
